body:
**Parent epic:** #278

**Depends on:** #280 (O1_INTERFACE_CONTRACT); iterate with #282

## Outcome
A dimensioned one-zone mechanical feasibility proposal using actual fixed panel positions and separate front jack/pot boards, local middle-board test piece and rear card.

## Deliverables
- Place real component envelopes, board thicknesses, seating planes, connectors, latches, supports and cable bend allowances. Current candidate planes include jack -10 mm, control -11.8 mm and octave -16/-29 mm; verify source and tolerances. Do not force equal spacing into a simple three-parallel-plane sketch.
- Compare independently supported front boards with short keyed flexible links to the middle; a rear card parallel to the middle, separately supported and removable rearward is a candidate. Direct mating, right-angle/side insertion remain alternatives only with validated latch access/extraction clearance.
- Existing JST GH top-entry wire-to-board mating height 7.3 mm is not a mezzanine board-spacing specification. Any alternative connector needs exact primary dimensional/force evidence before selection.
- Show supported insertion/extraction, jack/knob and rear-terminal force paths, board deflection and tolerance stack. Connector friction and solder joints cannot be structural support.
- Demonstrate access to all 6 trimmers, reference GND/power and measurement points with realistic screwdriver/probe/finger/loom envelopes, neighboring obstruction placeholders and rear cover. Avoid measurement additions that materially load sensitive nodes.
- Give assembly order and powered calibration versus **power-off/discharged** removal/replacement procedures; no hot swap and no owner soldering needed for routine service. Normal calibration should not require removing the middle board.
- If openings are proposed, assess route area, continuous return paths and stiffness, not just tool passage. Record enclosure-depth/support constraints requiring owner decisions.

## Acceptance
A traceable one-zone envelope and access drawing, interference/tolerance table and feasible assembly/removal sequence. Clearly distinguish geometric proposal from exact-part fit and physical verification. No full motherboard routing or hardware modification.

## Execution boundary
Planning deliverable under #278; **not started by issue creation**. Read #278, AGENTS.md and circuit/WORKFLOW.md before later authorized work. No production source/CAD changes, native campaigns, merge, fabrication, ordering or energization under the organization request. Preserve five OSC/all 33 functions/438 centres, canonical boards, decision.json and KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. Use exact source hashes and distinguish proposal, source/model evidence, native evidence and bench evidence. Missing checks are NOT RUN. Do not restart parked #242/E16 prompts or reopen completed finite-path/552-omission tasks. Keep pre-existing electrical and physical defects open.
title: [Design][03] Define one-zone stack and rear service access
